home.aboutArtiani.title: Artiani brings artworks closer to everyday life.
home.aboutArtiani.body: Artiani is a curated home for Levan Margiani's art textiles: tablecloths, round and rectangular cloths, table runners, decorative pillows, scarves, and other interior textiles shaped by Georgian design and traditional motifs.
home.aboutArtist.title: Levan Margiani works across painting, ornament, and material memory.
home.aboutArtist.body: Levan Margiani is a Georgian artist whose practice moves between painting, ornament, and material memory, carrying Georgian art into textiles, gifts, and objects made to live with.
home.hero.body: A calm new storefront for Levan Margiani's textile objects, built around material, ornament, and a slower way of choosing pieces for the home.
home.hero.fallback: Featured products will appear here as soon as active Supabase items are available for the homepage.
home.artist.title: Levan Margiani
home.artist.body: Artiani gathers Levan's textile practice into a more deliberate shop experience, where pattern, tactility, and domestic use sit as closely as the artwork itself.

page.track.title: Track order
page.track.body: Use your order code with your email or phone to track your Artiani order and review its current status.
checkout.title: Complete your order
checkout.body: Share your delivery details and review your Artiani textile order before placing it for bank transfer.
checkout.phoneHint: Use digits, spaces, parentheses, or a leading + only.
checkout.deliveryNoteAddress: Please enter your address accurately and in full to avoid delivery delays.
checkout.deliveryNoteFee: Delivery fee in Tbilisi is 5 GEL, and in the regions it is 10 GEL.
checkout.deliveryNoteTiming: Delivery takes up to 5 working days in Tbilisi and up to 7 working days in the regions.
checkout.paymentProcessBodyPrimary: After confirming your order, you will receive transfer instructions on the screen and by email. Please transfer the amount to the provided account and include your order code in the transfer reference.
checkout.paymentProcessBodySecondary: Once the transfer is received, order processing will begin. Delivery takes about 5 working days in Tbilisi and about 7 working days in the regions.
checkout.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
checkout.confirmationHint: Your order code appears immediately after a successful submission.
checkout.emptyBody: Your basket is empty. Add products before moving to checkout.
checkout.successEmailSent: Your order was saved and the confirmation email was sent.
checkout.successEmailFailed: Your order was saved, but the confirmation email could not be sent.
checkout.successNext: Keep your order code and complete the bank transfer below so order processing can begin.
checkout.nextStepsBody: Please transfer the amount to one of the bank accounts below and make sure to include the order code in the transfer description.
checkout.afterPaymentBody: After the transfer, order processing will begin as soon as the transfer is confirmed.
checkout.transferBody: Use one of the bank accounts below and include your order code in the transfer reference.
checkout.transferNote: Use your order code exactly as the transfer reference. We will confirm the order after the transfer is received.
track.title: Track order

track.notFound: No matching orders were found for that code and contact.
track.errorGeneric: Order lookup is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
